title: Let's build a Chatbot - Deployment and Blazor Server Summary (Part 17)

cues.en: Hi and welcome to part 17 of let's build a chatbot in C-Sharp using Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十七部分。

cues.en: Part 17 is the last of what I call season 1, meaning that we use Blazor server.
cues.zh: 第十七部分是我稱為第一季的最後一支，也就是使用 Blazor Server 的階段。

cues.en: There will be a season 2 with multiple things that we will cover at the end of this video.
cues.zh: 第二季會介紹其他內容，影片最後會說明。

cues.en: But for this last session, we are going to talk about deployment to Azure and a little
cues.zh: 這最後一單元要談部署到 Azure，並且稍微，

cues.en: summary about what we actually did so far in the last 17 hours.
cues.zh: 總結過去這些單元完成了什麼。

cues.en: So let's get into it.
cues.zh: 接著開始。

cues.en: So when we need to deploy, we have a bunch of options.
cues.zh: 需要部署時，有很多選項。

cues.en: Because we have Blazor server, there are certain things we can't use, like Azure functions, because they can't run the GUI.
cues.zh: 因為使用 Blazor Server，有些平台不能用，例如 Azure Functions，因為不能執行這個介面。

cues.en: We can't use static apps, because they can't run .NET, and similar like GitHub pages we can't use.
cues.zh: 也不能用靜態網站，因為無法執行 .NET，GitHub Pages 也一樣。

cues.en: But beyond that, if it can run .NET, it can more or less do it.
cues.zh: 除此之外，基本上只要能執行 .NET，就能使用。

cues.en: So there's Azure container apps for Aspire, because we use Aspire as a specific one, so we can get the dashboard up in the cloud as well.
cues.zh: 可以用 Aspire 專用的 Azure Container Apps，因為我們使用 Aspire，也能把 Dashboard 一起放上雲端。

cues.en: We can use container apps in general.
cues.zh: 也能使用一般 Container Apps。

cues.en: We could use Windows server app services, either for Windows or Linux.
cues.zh: 或是 Azure App Service，Windows 與 Linux 都可以。

cues.en: We could host it on our own web server, the Internet Information Server machine.
cues.zh: 也能自己架設 Web 伺服器，例如 IIS。

cues.en: There's nothing special here that couldn't run there.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有任何不能在那些環境運作的特殊功能。

cues.en: I've tried all these, not for this specific project, but in general for projects I've done in the past using AI.
cues.zh: 這些方式我都試過，雖然不是這個特定專案，但以前做的 AI 專案有使用。

cues.en: I haven't tried things like Azure Service Container, App Container Registration, or virtual machines, or the Docker Container Registration.
cues.zh: Azure 容器執行個體、容器登錄、虛擬機器，以及 Docker 等方式，這次沒有逐一測試。

cues.en: But there shouldn't be nothing stopping it from running.
cues.zh: 不過理論上沒有阻礙。

cues.en: So I did two of these.
cues.zh: 這次實際做了其中兩種。

cues.en: I have two deployments of the system, one being the app service, which is so easy to do.
cues.zh: 我部署了兩份系統，一份使用 App Service，非常容易。

cues.en: It took less than five minutes.
cues.zh: 不到五分鐘就完成。

cues.en: And then I tried this for the first time.
cues.zh: 接著第一次嘗試這個方式。

cues.en: I hadn't tried this before.
cues.zh: 我以前沒有試過。

cues.en: And this is really a nightmare to begin.
cues.zh: 開始時真的像惡夢。

cues.en: Once it's up and running, it's okay.
cues.zh: 一旦設定完成，倒是還可以。

cues.en: It's a bit slow, but it has some benefits, and that's why we are also trying to use it here.
cues.zh: 速度稍慢，但有一些優點，所以這裡也試著使用。

cues.en: But it took me over two hours to get working, and with a lot of help of AI from Codex, because
cues.zh: 我花了兩個多小時，還靠 Codex 大量協助，才讓它正常運作，因為，

cues.en: if you just right-click and say Publish in Visual Studio on the app host, it absolutely don't work.
cues.zh: 如果直接在 Visual Studio 對 AppHost 按右鍵、選 Publish，完全行不通。

cues.en: It has no concept of trying to use the parameters, so it makes wrong files behind the scenes. It's
cues.zh: 它不知道如何使用這些參數，因此背後建立錯誤的檔案，而且，

cues.en: slow. It just fails.
cues.zh: 很慢，最後只會失敗。

cues.en: AI can fix what it does.
cues.zh: AI 可以協助修正它產生的內容。

cues.en: But the out-of-the-box experience here is totally poor.
cues.zh: 但預設使用體驗真的很差。

cues.en: Of course, in real life, we would need to do workflows up in GitHub Actions, but for
cues.zh: 實際開發當然應該用 GitHub Actions 工作流程，不過，

cues.en: now I'm using the Publish feature.
cues.zh: 目前先使用 Publish 功能。

cues.en: And when I did it up here and published to App Service Windows, it just took a couple of seconds, and then it was done.
cues.zh: 部署到 Windows App Service 時，只花幾秒鐘就完成。

cues.en: While this first up, it failed in trying to publish to Central Sweden because there was
cues.zh: 但這個方式首先在 Sweden Central 失敗，因為，

cues.en: not enough capacity.
cues.zh: 容量不足。

cues.en: Then I tried another region where certain of these resources couldn't be spun up.
cues.zh: 接著換一個區域，某些資源又無法建立。

cues.en: Then I tried a third one, and every single time it takes like 20 to 30 minutes to get this up and running.
cues.zh: 再換第三個區域，而且每次建立都需要二十到三十分鐘。

cues.en: And it's not only me, it's also a lot of people having the same problem, seeing up to 90 minutes
cues.zh: 不只我遇到，很多人也有相同問題，有人等到九十分鐘，

cues.en: before these different resources have been spun up.
cues.zh: 這些資源才全部建立完成。

cues.en: So really, really poor experience, especially in the first time.
cues.zh: 因此第一次使用的體驗非常差。

cues.en: Now if we press Publish, yes, it will take a couple of minutes, but at least it does it.
cues.zh: 現在設定好之後，再按 Publish，雖然還需要幾分鐘，但至少能完成。

cues.en: So why do we keep up with this then?
cues.zh: 那為什麼還要忍受這些問題？

cues.en: Well, it's because the web app that I'm using, let's go to the different sites.
cues.zh: 因為目前使用的 Web App，先看看不同網站。

cues.en: So the web app I have here, it is running on the service plan F1, F0, meaning it's a free...
cues.zh: 這裡的 Web App 使用 F1 方案，也就是免費……

cues.en: Oh, it's called F1, it's not called F0.
cues.zh: 喔，它叫 F1，不是 F0。

cues.en: So if we look in here, these can be fairly heavy prices, as you can see over here.
cues.zh: 看看這些方案，價格可能相當高。

cues.en: This one is free, so I'm running here.
cues.zh: 這個是免費的，因此我使用它。

cues.en: But we can only have five of you trying out this setup, because WebSockets is locked down.
cues.zh: 但因為 WebSocket 連線有限制，同時大約只能讓五個人試用。

cues.en: We can set custom domains onto 3.1, and so on.
cues.zh: 自訂網域等功能也受到方案限制。

cues.en: So while it works, we can go to this one, mafchatbot.asiawebsite.net, it works, it feels pretty fast.
cues.zh: 所以它雖然能用，打開這個 azurewebsites.net 網站，速度也不錯。

cues.en: I'll try to say hello.
cues.zh: 試著說你好。

cues.en: And everything should be working.
cues.zh: 所有功能應該都能正常運作。

cues.en: So we see that things work as it should, but we can't really control too much.
cues.zh: 可以看到，功能符合預期，但可控制的設定有限。

cues.en: But for a demo like this, I'm giving it for free, having a different domain here is okay.
cues.zh: 不過這只是免費示範，使用這種網域也能接受。

cues.en: If we want to use a custom domain, and we want to use the container apps, the container
cues.zh: 如果想用自訂網域，也想使用 Container Apps，這個，

cues.en: apps roughly cost $5 a month to run, while the other one is free.
cues.zh: 容器應用程式每月大約五美元，另一個則免費。

cues.en: So I might take it down at some point, after you have tried it out.
cues.zh: 所以等大家試過之後，我可能會在某個時間關掉它。

cues.en: But what we get from the container app deployment is these various resources for registry, managed
cues.zh: Container Apps 部署會建立這些資源，包括 Registry、Managed，

cues.en: identity, log analytics, and so on.
cues.zh: Identity、Log Analytics 等等。

cues.en: It's much more opinionated, what goes in there.
cues.zh: 預設架構有較多固定選擇。

cues.en: The real one we are using is the Blazor server, which is the app itself.
cues.zh: 真正使用的應用程式，就是 Blazor Server。

cues.en: And it comes with a scale of one here, meaning it always runs, and up to 10 different autoscaling.
cues.zh: 它預設最少一個執行個體，代表持續運作，最多能自動擴展到十個。

cues.en: I don't like that, because that costs more money.
cues.zh: 我不喜歡這樣，因為比較花錢。

cues.en: So I put it down to zero and one, in order to save a bit of money, else it would have cost more.
cues.zh: 因此改成最少零個、最多一個，省一些費用，否則成本會更高。

cues.en: But we have the option to add custom domains.
cues.zh: 不過它支援加入自訂網域。

cues.en: So I have my own domain, rwj.dk.
cues.zh: 我有自己的網域 rwj.dk。

cues.en: And I went into my hosting provider and made a CNAME and a txt file.
cues.zh: 到網域服務商加入 CNAME 與 TXT 記錄。

cues.en: And doing that made it possible to add a custom domain here, which was nice.
cues.zh: 這樣就能在這裡綁定自訂網域，很方便。

cues.en: So when we are on this, we can see this URL, or use the now custom domain, but we can also
cues.zh: 在這裡可以查看原始 URL，或使用自訂網域，另外也能，

cues.en: go and see the dashboard.
cues.zh: 查看 Dashboard。

cues.en: So the dashboard is here, running up in the system, with the custom domain URL and the
cues.zh: Dashboard 已在雲端執行，可以看到自訂網域 URL，與，

cues.en: Blazor server URL, and so on.
cues.zh: Blazor Server 的 URL 等資訊。

cues.en: So we have options to that.
cues.zh: 因此有這些額外功能。

cues.en: One special thing you need to know is that you can't see the parameters anymore, once they're deployed.
cues.zh: 有一件特別要知道：部署後，就看不到原本的 Parameters 畫面。

cues.en: When you need to see them, they are down in secrets here, and are being auto-populated, which is kind of nice, compared to over here.
cues.zh: 要查看參數，改到下面的 Secrets，它會自動填入，比另一個方式方便。

cues.en: You need to put them in yourself, into the system like this.
cues.zh: 另一邊需要像這樣，自己把值填入系統。

cues.en: Because everything is environment variable, so we need to put them in.
cues.zh: 因為全部都是環境變數，需要自行提供。

cues.en: I actually made Codex do it for me, using their build over here.
cues.zh: 我其實請 Codex 透過建置工具完成。

cues.en: So that was not a big deal, but once they're up there, it should be running.
cues.zh: 所以不是太麻煩。設定上去後，應該就能執行。

cues.en: By the way, I made some fairly large changes to the app host itself, putting these into
cues.zh: 另外，AppHost 本身也做了不小的修改，把這些內容，

cues.en: various extension methods, and also renamed them a bunch.
cues.zh: 移到不同擴充方法，也重新命名了不少項目。

cues.en: So when we run it locally here, we will see that most of these are now in app settings instead.
cues.zh: 因此現在本機執行時，大多數非秘密設定都改放 AppSettings。

cues.en: All the non-secrets are here, and in local, under parameters, we only have the ones that
cues.zh: 非秘密值在這裡，Parameters 中只保留那些，

cues.en: are actually truly secrets.
cues.zh: 真正敏感的值。

cues.en: So there's two places to see, and there's a few name changes in there.
cues.zh: 所以有兩個設定位置，也有幾項名稱變更。

cues.en: So if you have already gotten the code, you might need to reset these.
cues.zh: 如果先前已下載程式碼，可能需要重新設定。

cues.en: But if we go back here, and see the system, and we see the real one here, we can now go
cues.zh: 回到實際網站，現在可以，

cues.en: to maa-chatbot.rwj, and if we just refresh here, we can see that we get different logins.
cues.zh: 開啟自訂網域的聊天機器人，重新整理後，就能看到不同登入選項。

cues.en: And of course, we can log in and log out with the various different providers here.
cues.zh: 當然也可以透過不同供應商登入、登出。

cues.en: Of course, when I did all this, we got some new URLs, custom domains, and so on.
cues.zh: 部署後多了新的 URL、自訂網域等資訊，

cues.en: So I needed to go into port zero, and the app settings for intra, and put in the new callback URLs, allowed callbacks.
cues.zh: 因此必須到 Auth0 與 Entra 設定，加入新的允許 Callback URL。

cues.en: It also, of course, didn't work, but that's just normal setup of identity providers.
cues.zh: 這部分一開始也沒成功，不過就是一般身分供應商設定。

cues.en: But I can log in.
cues.zh: 現在可以登入。

cues.en: I already logged in with my GitHub here, so it just goes in directly, and it shows me the data.
cues.zh: 前面已使用 GitHub 登入，因此會直接進入，並顯示我的資料。

cues.en: So that is all good and well, and we are up and running.
cues.zh: 目前一切正常，系統已經啟動。

cues.en: But again, you can drop whatever of these, AI is not picky in running in all kinds of
cues.zh: 同樣地，可以選擇任何這些部署方式，AI 本身不挑，

cues.en: different environments.
cues.zh: 執行環境。

cues.en: So deployment is not difficult beyond the deployment part.
cues.zh: 因此除了平台部署本身，AI 沒有額外增加太多困難。

cues.en: So now, let's talk a little about what we have learned in this.
cues.zh: 接著總結學到了什麼。

cues.en: So this is a wrap-up of season one.
cues.zh: 這是第一季的回顧。

cues.en: We have made conversations, streaming, image generation, tool calling, token usage, reasoning,
cues.zh: 我們加入了對話、串流、圖像生成、工具呼叫、Token 用量、推理，

cues.en: user memory, MCP servers, attachments, audio transcripts, storage of the various conversations
cues.zh: 使用者記憶、MCP 伺服器、附件、語音轉錄、對話與，

cues.en: and settings in Cosmos DB and Blob Storage, and we have added multiple port providers.
cues.zh: 設定儲存，使用 Cosmos DB 與 Blob Storage，也加入多種驗證供應商。

cues.en: So a lot and a lot of things, but also one thing I often come back to when I do these
cues.zh: 確實做了很多。不過每次做這些專案，我常常又會想到，

cues.en: things, and I have mentioned this in the past and to others, is that the AI part of such
cues.zh: 過去也和其他人提過：這類系統中，AI 的部分，

cues.en: things like we do here, it's actually not that big.
cues.zh: 其實沒有那麼大。

cues.en: It's often that it's just a little tip of the iceberg, but we do a lot of other things, deployment, storage, GUI, audio, configuration, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 往往只是冰山一角，其他還有部署、儲存、介面、音訊、設定等等。

cues.en: So no matter how we build code, we always need more than just the AI.
cues.zh: 因此無論如何開發，都不只需要 AI。

cues.en: And to just prove that a bit, I made a small summary of what we have done so far.
cues.zh: 為了稍微證明這點，我整理了目前的程式碼統計。

cues.en: And as you can see, almost 60% of the code we have written, we have written around 5,000
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個專案大約寫了五千，

cues.en: lines of code in this project, and almost 60% of it is actually GUI, Razor Components,
cues.zh: 行程式碼，將近六成其實都是介面，包括 Razor 元件，

cues.en: CSS, JavaScript, and so on.
cues.zh: CSS、JavaScript 等等。

cues.en: The Cosmos and the Blob Storage are 14-15%, the hosting is 9%, authentication code is
cues.zh: Cosmos 與 Blob Storage 占約 14% 到 15%，託管約 9%，驗證程式碼，

cues.en: 7%, and first at roughly a little under 7% is actually the AI code.
cues.zh: 約 7%，真正的 AI 程式碼則略低於 7%。

cues.en: We've only written 366 lines of AI code.
cues.zh: AI 程式碼只寫了 366 行。

cues.en: It's quite normal.
cues.zh: 這很正常。

cues.en: It's not like that that's a problem or anything.
cues.zh: 並不是什麼問題。

cues.en: It's also a really cool nod to agent framework being so concise and so easy to work with that you don't need a lot of lines of code.
cues.zh: 也證明 Agent Framework 很精簡、很容易使用，不需要大量程式碼。

cues.en: They might be the hard lines of code that you need to write, but it is an easy framework, which is really, really nice.
cues.zh: 這些可能是比較難寫的行數，但框架本身很好用，這點非常棒。

cues.en: But just be aware that whenever you start a project, you will end up writing a lot of
cues.zh: 不過要注意，開始專案時，最後一定會寫很多，

cues.en: non-AI code, and also be data cleanup if it's input of data and so on.
cues.zh: 非 AI 程式碼，如果有資料輸入，也包括清理資料等等。

cues.en: So just be aware that just because you're using AI doesn't mean that it's like 50% of the code.
cues.zh: 因此不要以為使用 AI，AI 程式碼就會占一半。

cues.en: It's often a very, very low number.
cues.zh: 它通常只占很小的比例。

cues.en: So that is Season 1.
cues.zh: 第一季到這裡結束。

cues.en: Season 2 will start in August 2026.
cues.zh: 第二季會在 2026 年八月開始。

cues.en: I will take a couple of weeks now off for summer vacation, so no more videos in July.
cues.zh: 接下來會休幾週暑假，因此七月不再更新影片。

cues.en: But Season 2 has a few planned videos.
cues.zh: 第二季已經規劃了幾支影片。

cues.en: I'm going to make some other backends.
cues.zh: 會建立其他後端。

cues.en: I'm going to make a minimal API backend and an Azure Function backend in order to actually have other frontends as well.
cues.zh: 包括 Minimal API 與 Azure Functions 後端，讓我們也能使用其他前端。

cues.en: We'll probably do Blazor Vassal, and we will also do a React frontend, despite me not knowing React right now.
cues.zh: 可能會做 Blazor WebAssembly，也會做 React，即使目前我還不懂 React。

cues.en: But luckily, I have Codex to help me do that.
cues.zh: 但幸好有 Codex 可以協助。

cues.en: Some people have also asked for RAC usage.
cues.zh: 也有觀眾要求加入 RAG。

cues.en: So right now, it's just a chatbot that can use its world knowledge, but we'll try to add RAC users in.
cues.zh: 目前只是使用模型世界知識的聊天機器人，之後會嘗試加入 RAG。

cues.en: In general, there's more ideas on what we need to do, telemetry, testing, and such things.
cues.zh: 另外也有更多想法，例如遙測、測試等等。

cues.en: And it all depends on what you want to see.
cues.zh: 取決於你想看到什麼。

cues.en: In the repo, rwj-chatbot, there is an open issues list with different things, and you
cues.zh: rwj-chatbot 儲存庫中，有公開的 Issue 清單，列出不同工作，你也，

cues.en: can add more if you want to, to what you feel like we should put in.
cues.zh: 可以加入自己覺得應該實作的內容。

cues.en: But some of the ones I just mentioned are here.
cues.zh: 剛剛提到的一些項目，已經列在這裡。

cues.en: We could look at ADUI, A2A, and such things, skills, and so on.
cues.zh: 也可以看看 AG-UI、A2A、技能等功能。

cues.en: So, sound out in the comments, or add comments here, or add your own ideas what should be in Season 2 of Let's Build a Chatbot.
cues.zh: 歡迎留言，或在這裡加入建議，告訴我第二季應該包含哪些內容。

cues.en: But for now, have a nice summer, and see you in Season 2.
cues.zh: 目前先祝大家暑假愉快，第二季見。
